input.rationale: Section 12.b gives a TrueLink indemnity, but it is limited to claims "arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder" (p0075). It therefore does not cover third-party claims that the Interface, Hosting Services or Support Services infringe or misappropriate IP rights, nor TrueLink's breach of law, data breach or wilful misconduct as independent triggers. No IP infringement indemnity appears elsewhere: the only infringement provisions are Client-side warranties (§8e, p0055) and a Client covenant not to infringe TrueLink IP (p0024). Because a Vendor IP indemnity is absent, the clause fails even the fallback (Vendor IP indemnity with usual exclusions and remedies), and the Client-side indemnity at 12.a is by contrast very broad. Redline inserts the missing TrueLink indemnity with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure and Client Content / Client modification carve-outs; we have left the Client indemnity at 12.a untouched as the smallest edit.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity at 12.b covers only its own breach of this Agreement, so it does not reach third-party claims that the Interface or Hosting Services infringe IP rights — the risk we cannot control or diligence. We have added a standard vendor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach caused by TrueLink and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with usual notice/control/cooperation procedure and carve-outs for Client Content and Client modifications; we can discuss a super-cap on this indemnity if helpful.

ops.text: c. Without limiting the foregoing, TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable furnished by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, allow the indemnifying party to control the defense (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent) and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. TrueLink shall have no obligation under clause (i) to the extent the claim arises from Client Content or from Client's unauthorized modification or combination of the Interface.
